run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit of ConfigMap 'service-manifest' in every namespace whose name starts with 'app-283'. Four such namespaces exist in the cluster (app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search), and each contains a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' with an 'audit_code' key. Cluster-wide read of all 29 ConfigMaps returned exactly these four 'service-manifest' objects, and per-namespace reads confirmed the same values one namespace at a time: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q, app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V, app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z, app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. All four also carry owner=platform-team and tier=standard. No health or incident conclusion is drawn here: this is a read-only configuration audit, and the readings are the cluster state at query time (2026-11-21T09:10:37Z to 09:10:39Z), not a historical record of the incident window.

claims.text: Exactly four namespaces in the cluster have names starting with 'app-283': app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search (out of 12 namespaces processed).

A cluster-wide read of ConfigMaps filtered to metadata.name == 'service-manifest' returned four objects, one per app-283-* namespace, each with an audit_code value and with owner=platform-team, tier=standard.
In namespace app-283-billing, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' has audit_code = TDW283-BLX94Q (owner=platform-team, tier=standard).
In namespace app-283-ledger, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' has audit_code = TDW283-QGF48V (owner=platform-team, tier=standard).
In namespace app-283-media, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' has audit_code = TDW283-MDP61Z (owner=platform-team, tier=standard).
In namespace app-283-search, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' has audit_code = TDW283-SRK27M (owner=platform-team, tier=standard).

gaps: Every ConfigMap reading is the object's state at query time (observed_at 2026-11-21T09:10:37Z–09:10:39Z); nothing here shows what the audit_code values were earlier in the authorized window, since change history is not integrated in this Run.

The namespaces listing returned 4 matches out of 12 namespaces processed, but a namespace created and deleted between then and now would not appear; absence of other app-283-* namespaces is therefore a snapshot observation, not proof of what existed earlier.
No pod, deployment, event or log evidence was examined in this Run, so no statement is made about the health or impact on any workload using these ConfigMaps.
next_steps: If the audit needs to be attributable to a point in time, re-read the same four ConfigMaps against a change-history or audit-log source, which is not available in this Run.
If any workload consuming these ConfigMaps must be certified as behaving per its declared tier, inspect that workload's own pods, events and application logs separately.
